movie.title: Justin the Just
movie.overview: France, World War I. Justin (Alban Ivanov), an illiterate peasant farmer is enrolled in French army. Knowing nothing of the World or the War, Justin finds himself on the front without understanding why he must kill men he’s never met. Naïve and open minded, Justin will cross the path of a German pilot and a Senegalese soldier, escape a prisoner camp and start a mutiny to prevent his fellow comrades to risk their lives. Through his journey Justin will question the absurdity of war, make lifetime friends and inspire many…

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: An illiterate French peasant conscripted into World War I, Justin navigates the absurdity of war, forming unlikely friendships and inspiring mutiny, all while questioning the senseless violence.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Justin, an illiterate French peasant, is drafted into World War I with no understanding of the conflict. On the front lines, his naivete leads him to befriend a German pilot and a Senegalese soldier, questioning the rationale behind the fighting. He escapes a prisoner camp and incites a mutiny to save his fellow soldiers, ultimately discovering the profound absurdity of war and forming enduring bonds.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: In World War I France, Justin, an uneducated peasant farmer, is conscripted into the French army, completely oblivious to the war or its global implications. Thrust onto the front lines, he struggles to comprehend why he must kill men he doesn't know. His inherent naivete and open-mindedness lead him to unexpected encounters, including forming a bond with a German pilot and a Senegalese soldier. After being captured, Justin manages to escape a prisoner camp, further solidifying his anti-war sentiments. Driven by a desire to protect his comrades from senseless danger, he instigates a mutiny, urging them to refuse orders that would risk their lives. Throughout his tumultuous journey, Justin confronts the inherent absurdity of war, makes lasting friendships, and becomes an unlikely source of inspiration for many around him, forever changing his perspective on conflict and humanity.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Set against the backdrop of World War I, 'Justin the Just' follows Justin, an uneducated French peasant farmer who is forcibly conscripted into the army. Having lived a life isolated from global events, Justin finds himself on the front lines without any understanding of the conflict or the rationale behind the violence. His innocent and open-minded nature allows him to transcend the manufactured animosity of war, leading to remarkable encounters with a German pilot and a Senegalese soldier, people he's told are his enemies. After a dramatic escape from a prisoner-of-war camp, Justin becomes even more convinced of the senselessness of the fighting. Driven by a burgeoning sense of justice and a deep concern for his fellow soldiers, he bravely incites a mutiny to prevent them from embarking on a suicide mission. Through these profound experiences, Justin not only challenges the very notion of war but also forges powerful, lifelong friendships and emerges as an unexpected beacon of inspiration for those around him, ultimately questioning the cost of conflict and the true meaning of humanity amidst chaos.

story_structure.climax: After escaping captivity, Justin instigates a dangerous mutiny among his fellow soldiers to halt a futile mission and protect them from senseless slaughter.
story_structure.conflict: Thrown onto the front lines, Justin struggles to comprehend the absurdity of a brutal war and why he is expected to kill total strangers.
story_structure.resolution: Through his innocence and courage, Justin inspires his comrades, leaves a lasting impact on those around him, and forever challenges the meaningless violence of war.
story_structure.introduction: Justin, an illiterate and naive French peasant farmer with no knowledge of the outside world, is abruptly conscripted into the French army during World War I.
story_structure.risingAction: Navigating the horror of combat with an open heart, Justin forms unexpected bonds with a Senegalese soldier and a captured German pilot before enduring capture and imprisonment in a POW camp.
